cobbleeffort.fossil.minnolith.name: Minnow Fossil
cobbleeffort.fossil.mycolith.name: Spire Fossil
cobbleeffort.fossil.petroleodd.name: Ancient Tar
cobbleeffort.fossil.scorpaddle.name: Telson Fossil
cobbleeffort.species.absinthia.desc: Artists in ancient cities sought out Absinthia for inspiration, though staring too long into its swirling emerald eyes causes vivid hallucinations.
cobbleeffort.species.absinthia.name: Absinthia
cobbleeffort.species.aetherim.desc: A little golem of pure energy that shapes a body around a pearl. Give it a tuft of hair charged with a type's energy and it soaks it up, glowing that type's colour and becoming that type.
cobbleeffort.species.aetherim.name: Aetherim
cobbleeffort.species.agavolem.desc: Agavolem spends decades absorbing desert sunlight into its spiky core. When baked by volcanic heat, its sap turns into a sweet, fiery nectar.
cobbleeffort.species.agavolem.name: Agavolem
cobbleeffort.species.alembix.desc: It grows a long, gracefully curved swan-neck pipe from its head that coils into a cooling tank on its back. It constantly drips crystal-clear distilled water from its spout, purifying polluted ponds wherever it walks.
cobbleeffort.species.alembix.name: Alembix
cobbleeffort.species.amalgum.desc: Three Cavitot that had their cavities filled and fused into one. The metal in their fillings makes it tough to crack, but all three of its faces still frown. It gnaws on iron ore to keep its caps shiny.
cobbleeffort.species.amalgum.name: Amalgum
cobbleeffort.species.amoonguss-cobbleeff: It screws itself deep into rock with its two threaded arms and stays there for years. Old mines are held up by colonies of them, and a miner who pulls one out may bring the tunnel down.
cobbleeffort.species.arpsant.desc: It strings a curved twig with leaves to make a harp. Its music calms angry Pokémon, and the leaves it plays on glow faintly when it is in a good mood.
cobbleeffort.species.arpsant.name: Arpsant
cobbleeffort.species.ashtraylor.desc: Travelers use Ashtraylor's basin-like back to safely extinguish campfires. It absorbs the leftover cinders to harden its stony shell.
cobbleeffort.species.ashtraylor.name: Ashtraylor
cobbleeffort.species.assoulsect.desc: When thousands of Bug Pokémon perished, a fungus took root in what was left of them and wove their souls into one mind. Their old heads and blades still twitch in its fog; any Bug Pokémon that challenges it is pulled into the hive and turns on its own allies.
cobbleeffort.species.assoulsect.name: Assoulsect
cobbleeffort.species.avalanchehound.desc: A massive, heroic canine wearing two heavy oak barrels strapped across its broad shoulders like cannon pods. It charges through ten-foot snowdrifts effortlessly, launching pressurized blasts of warming tonic to shatter ice walls.
cobbleeffort.species.avalanchehound.name: Avalanche Hound
cobbleeffort.species.bacchudrake.desc: Said to appear only once a century during the grandest autumn harvest, Bacchudrake's joyous roar turns ordinary river water into sparkling nectar.
cobbleeffort.species.bacchudrake.name: Bacchudrake
cobbleeffort.species.blanketula.desc: When it outgrows its seed it picks out a big leaf and never lets go of it again. It sleeps wrapped up in it, hides under it when anything startles it, and grows very upset if the leaf is taken away.
cobbleeffort.species.blanketula.name: Blanketula
cobbleeffort.species.blaxer.desc: It bounds into battle and boxes with its front paws, faster than the eye can follow. The spiked collar round its neck grows from its own fur.
cobbleeffort.species.blaxer.name: Blaxer
cobbleeffort.species.bongwater.desc: Its belly gurgles with every breath it draws through its glass neck. The water inside slowly turns brown, and it has to swim in clean rivers to rinse itself out.
cobbleeffort.species.bongwater.name: Bongwater
cobbleeffort.species.bootlegger.desc: A little smuggler that hauls a stolen jug through the woods at dusk. If it is caught, it plays dead until whoever caught it looks away, then bolts with whatever it can carry.
cobbleeffort.species.bootlegger.name: Bootlegger
cobbleeffort.species.boracle.desc: It gazes into its crystal ball and tells the fortunes of anyone who brings it food. Its predictions are always right, though it is careful to say only the good ones out loud.
cobbleeffort.species.boracle.name: Boracle
cobbleeffort.species.brawlerry.desc: Brawlerry loves noisy taverns and friendly sparring. Though it stumbles unpredictably when dizzy, its wild haymakers hit with devastating force.
cobbleeffort.species.brawlerry.name: Brawlerry
cobbleeffort.species.brenkey.desc: It sips water up through its bamboo straw and squirts it at anyone who bothers it. It acts tough, but it would much rather be napping.
cobbleeffort.species.brenkey.name: Brenkey
cobbleeffort.species.butterfree-cobbleef: Its wings shine violet and gold so no predator forgets them: one taste of their scales leaves a bird Pokémon numb for days. Flocks of them drift over jungle canopies, and the trees they rest in turn faintly purple.
cobbleeffort.species.calligrimm.desc: A titan of living ink, tall as a castle tower. The shards of its shattered inkwell became its fangs, and old tales say whatever it writes with its claws comes true, so kingdoms once begged it never to write their names.
cobbleeffort.species.calligrimm.name: Calligrimm
cobbleeffort.species.capybrute.desc: It lounges by rivers as calmly as a boulder and lets other Pokémon nap on its back, but it digs burrows through solid rock with those claws. Rile it and it charges with its head down, shrugging off blows that would flatten a house.
cobbleeffort.species.capybrute.name: Capybrute
cobbleeffort.species.cardling.desc: It sings sweetly from the branches at dawn, and its song is said to bring good luck to anyone who hears it first thing in the morning. It is tiny, round and fearless.
cobbleeffort.species.cardling.name: Cardling
cobbleeffort.species.cartelord.desc: Cartelord controls vast swaths of farmland. Once a Pokémon gets a taste of the sweet nectar it produces, it refuses to eat anything else.
cobbleeffort.species.cartelord.name: Cartelord
cobbleeffort.species.caskade.desc: Caskade wanders mountain trails for decades, allowing rainwater and wild berries to ferment inside its oaken shell into a prized elixir.
cobbleeffort.species.caskade.name: Caskade
cobbleeffort.species.caterpie-cobbleeffo: Its purple body warns every bird Pokémon away: it is laced with poison from the toxic leaves it eats. When something comes too close it rears up and flicks out its pink, forked feeler, which oozes a stinging, foul-smelling liquid.
cobbleeffort.species.cavitot.desc: It started out as a baby tooth that was never brushed. The cavity in its crown aches all the time, which is why it always looks so grumpy. It can't resist sweets, even though they make the ache worse.
cobbleeffort.species.cavitot.name: Cavitot
cobbleeffort.species.cerbego.desc: It guards the way to the land of the dead. The souls it has turned back burn beside it as purple ghost-fire, and in battle they flare up as two more heads.
cobbleeffort.species.cerbego.name: Cerbego
cobbleeffort.species.chawchamp.desc: Chawchamp constantly chews on bitter herbs to stay focused during sparring matches. Its jaw strength can crush a Geodude.
cobbleeffort.species.chawchamp.name: Chawchamp
cobbleeffort.species.chawp.desc: It picks fights with anything bigger than itself just to prove how tough it is, and it never stays down. Whether it trains its strikes, its throws or its kicks decides what it becomes.
cobbleeffort.species.chawp.name: Chawp
cobbleeffort.species.cigarghast.desc: Said to haunt old study rooms and velvet lounges, Cigarghast's glowing ember eye is often the only thing visible in the dark.
cobbleeffort.species.cigarghast.name: Cigarghast
cobbleeffort.species.cinderoon.desc: Once it has eaten enough coal, it wraps its soft body in a cocoon of cinders. The ash is thin enough to see the Coalarva curled up inside, and it can burn some of it away to hurl a blast of fire at anything that disturbs it.
cobbleeffort.species.cinderoon.name: Cinderoon
cobbleeffort.species.coalarva.desc: It lives in caves deep underground where coal seams run thick, and it eats nothing but coal. A special organ in its abdomen turns the minerals it swallows into heat, which is why its tail end always glows.
cobbleeffort.species.coalarva.name: Coalarva
cobbleeffort.species.copperpot.desc: A small, round, riveted copper kettle with stubby legs and a whistling lid. It collects morning dew and rainwater inside its hollow body, keeping it remarkably pure.
cobbleeffort.species.copperpot.name: Copperpot
cobbleeffort.species.corkscrew.desc: Corkscrew spins rapidly to bore through wooden casks and dense tree bark. The sound of it taking flight echoes like a popping bottle.
cobbleeffort.species.corkscrew.name: Corkscrew
cobbleeffort.species.crabgron.desc: As it grows, its claw takes on the look of an iron-armoured beast, horns and all. Crabgron bang their helmet-claws on rocks at night so that anything listening believes a whole herd is near.
cobbleeffort.species.crabgron.name: Crabgron
cobbleeffort.species.creepish.desc: It lurks in dark lagoons with only its frill above the water. When it spreads the frill and raises its arms, even large Pokémon back away.
cobbleeffort.species.creepish.name: Creepish
cobbleeffort.species.croissoar.desc: Its blanket of dough rises and bakes into a great flaky paraglider. It leaps off hilltops and rides the warm air for miles, steering with its ears, and leaves a trail of buttery crumbs behind it.
cobbleeffort.species.croissoar.name: Croissoar
cobbleeffort.species.curedrake.desc: As its leaves mature, they turn a rich, golden-amber hue and curl inward like drying tobacco bundles. It hangs upside down from sturdy branches, slowly fermenting its internal sap into a potent, dizzying toxin.
cobbleeffort.species.curedrake.name: Curedrake
cobbleeffort.species.cutlassfly.desc: Its wings are blades sharp enough to slice falling leaves in two. It hovers perfectly still over rivers, then darts away faster than the eye can follow, leaving cut reeds behind it.
cobbleeffort.species.cutlassfly.name: Cutlassfly
cobbleeffort.species.dracarabo.desc: The horn on its head grows into the shape of a dragon's skull, jaws and all. It charges with the jaws wide open, and the snap when they close can be heard right across the savanna.
cobbleeffort.species.dracarabo.name: Dracarabo
cobbleeffort.species.elastigoose.desc: Its neck stretches like rubber, letting it snatch food from the riverbed or honk right in a foe's face from far away. Its honk is so loud it can be heard three valleys over.
cobbleeffort.species.elastigoose.name: Elastigoose
cobbleeffort.species.emberbutt.desc: It feeds on dry paper and dry leaves to keep the tip of its snout glowing. If extinguished, it falls into a deep, sluggish sleep.
cobbleeffort.species.emberbutt.name: Emberbutt
cobbleeffort.species.fangfosh.desc: It is always grinning like that, even when it is scared, which makes it very hard to tell what it is feeling. It hops out of the water on its little legs to bite at ankles.
cobbleeffort.species.fangfosh.name: Fangfosh
cobbleeffort.species.fishugly.desc: It wanders the riverbanks on its long fin-legs, staring at everything with its unblinking eyes. It buries itself in the mud to sleep, with only its grin showing.
cobbleeffort.species.fishugly.name: Fishugly
cobbleeffort.species.flachiko.desc: It scowls at everyone it meets, but its flame tail wags uncontrollably when it is happy. Its fur is warm enough to sleep against on cold nights.
cobbleeffort.species.flachiko.name: Flachiko
cobbleeffort.species.flambeer.desc: Its liquid body is so pure and volatile that a single spark sets its surface ablaze with a cool, ghost-blue flame.
cobbleeffort.species.flambeer.name: Flambéer
cobbleeffort.species.foongus-cobbleeffor: It burrows into the ground by spinning on the spot, and pokes up its steel cap looking just like a screw that someone dropped. Miners who try to pick it up get a face full of spores.
cobbleeffort.species.forgnash.desc: Once it stands on two legs, the fire inside it bursts out through its back. It hammers metal ore with its claws to sharpen them, and the sparks fly like a forge.
cobbleeffort.species.forgnash.name: Forgnash
cobbleeffort.species.gastly-cobbleeffort: A cyclops ball of hellfire wrapped in burning gas. It drifts over badlands and deserts on hot nights, and anything that breathes its gas feels faint and feverish for days.
cobbleeffort.species.gatterfly.desc: Its arms have become guns that spray stingers so fast and so hot they glow, and its wings are made of fire. Besides fighting with them, it melts stone with its flames to build its nest.
cobbleeffort.species.gatterfly.name: Gatterfly
cobbleeffort.species.gengar-cobbleeffort: Its third eye sees the souls of the living. On the hottest nights its mane of hellfire flares up, and it grins as it chases the shadows of travellers through the badlands.
cobbleeffort.species.gigantler.desc: The antlers on its head grow back bigger every year, and an old bull's three crowns can span wider than a cabin. Packs of predators turn back the moment it lowers its head, and travellers in the northern woods take a glimpse of one as a sign of good fortune.
cobbleeffort.species.gigantler.name: Gigantler
cobbleeffort.species.haunter-cobbleeffor: It licks its prey with its long, ice-cold blue tongue, and the victim shivers even as the flames on its sides scorch the grass. Its floating hands can grab you from across a room.
cobbleeffort.species.hookahdra.desc: By drawing air through its water-filled belly, Hookahdra cools down its internal furnace, releasing sweet-smelling clouds from its many snouts.
cobbleeffort.species.hookahdra.name: Hookahdra
cobbleeffort.species.hopple.desc: A timid little rabbit that is never far from its den. When one is in danger it thumps the ground, and its whole family comes running.
cobbleeffort.species.hopple.name: Hopple
cobbleeffort.species.hopsprout.desc: Brewers prize Hopsprout for the bitter, floral oils on its petals. When frightened, it releases a musky scent that puts predators to sleep.
cobbleeffort.species.hopsprout.name: Hopsprout
cobbleeffort.species.hornworm.desc: While most Bug-types avoid Nicotiny, Hornworm devours entire fields of them, storing the bitter alkaloids in its body to deter predators.
cobbleeffort.species.hornworm.name: Hornworm
cobbleeffort.species.hypnodose.desc: Hypnodose latches onto stressed Pokémon, releasing a calm, rhythmic psychic pulse that eases agitation—though removing it causes sudden irritability.
cobbleeffort.species.hypnodose.name: Hypnodose
cobbleeffort.species.ibuprofeon.desc: An Eevee that hung on at the very edge of fainting evolved into Ibuprofeon. It is never without its bandages, and the pills on its tail ease the pain of any Pokémon that curls up beside it.
cobbleeffort.species.ibuprofeon.name: Ibuprofeon
cobbleeffort.species.ignitemare.desc: When the CobbleEffort Mudbray's sulking turns to rage, its body burns away to a shadow round its bones. It gallops through badlands at night, snorting fire, and its hollow skull glows red with the grudges it refuses to let go.
cobbleeffort.species.ignitemare.name: Ignitemare
cobbleeffort.species.incl.desc: A drop of ink that came to life on the page of an old letter. The silver pen nib it wears as a face is sharp, and it scribbles angry lines on anything that bothers it.
cobbleeffort.species.incl.name: Incl
cobbleeffort.species.incwell.desc: It lives in an inkwell it found in an abandoned study and never leaves it. At night it rises out of the well and writes threats on the walls with the tip of its nib.
cobbleeffort.species.incwell.name: Incwell
cobbleeffort.species.jerbolt.desc: It floats over desert dunes at night with its tail curled round it in a ring. Anything that stares at the turning ring for long falls into a daze, and Jerbolt hops off with its food.
cobbleeffort.species.jerbolt.name: Jerbolt
cobbleeffort.species.joltini.desc: Joltini vibrates at high frequencies, creating static sparks along its rim. One sip of its electrified nectar can keep a trainer awake for three days.
cobbleeffort.species.joltini.name: Joltini
cobbleeffort.species.jormbuoy.desc: It bobs along on cold seas under a hull of old ship's timbers, shields lined up along its sides. Sailors used to tie their boats to it, mistaking it for a buoy, until it swam away with them.
cobbleeffort.species.jormbuoy.name: Jormbuoy
cobbleeffort.species.jorminous.desc: The ghost of a sunken raiding ship that has become a great sea serpent. When it rises out of the fog with its shields gleaming and its oars beating, whole fleets turn back to shore.
cobbleeffort.species.jorminous.name: Jorminous
cobbleeffort.species.karkuttle.desc: Its legs are so long it can step over a fallen log without slowing down. It waits with its eyes half shut and its antennae spread wide, then lashes out with its claws from three body lengths away.
cobbleeffort.species.karkuttle.name: Karkuttle
cobbleeffort.species.kegguard.desc: A sturdy, thick-furred mountain dog carrying a reinforced iron-banded cask under its chin. It braves blizzards to locate stranded travelers, sharing warming sips of its herbal tonic to thaw frozen limbs.
cobbleeffort.species.kegguard.name: Kegguard
cobbleeffort.species.kiq-gi.desc: A Kiq that has earned the Master's Gi. Its kicks are so fast the air freezes in their wake; frost grows over its shoulders, and icicles over its hips.
cobbleeffort.species.kiq.desc: The kickboxer of the trinity it forms with Sawk and Throh. It keeps its guard up at all times and fights only with its legs; one of its kicks can snap a tree trunk clean through.
cobbleeffort.species.kiq.name: Kiq
cobbleeffort.species.larvorub.desc: It tunnels through rotting logs on the jungle floor and eats anything softer than its horns. When something startles it, it rears up and points those horns, though they are still too soft to hurt.
cobbleeffort.species.larvorub.name: Larvorub
cobbleeffort.species.lesbeon.desc: Two Eevee that love each other evolve together into Lesbeon. It stays fiercely loyal to its partner and protects her from anything, and the Venus marks that hang from its ears glow when the two are close.
cobbleeffort.species.lesbeon.name: Lesbeon
cobbleeffort.species.lycanmoon.desc: It ropes its opponents with a vine lasso and pulls them into the reach of its fists. Under a full moon it howls so loudly that every Wigwoof for miles answers.
cobbleeffort.species.lycanmoon.name: Lycanmoon
cobbleeffort.species.magmalodon.desc: Its body burns hotter than a smelter, and the smoke pouring off its head hangs down its back like dreadlocks. A single bite from its huge jaws can tear through a steel girder.
cobbleeffort.species.magmalodon.name: Magmalodon
cobbleeffort.species.magnalien.desc: A mothership that carries the little saucers it was formed from docked round its rim. It hovers silently over fields at night, and whatever its rainbow beam touches is never quite where it was left in the morning.
cobbleeffort.species.magnalien.name: Magnalien
cobbleeffort.species.magnemite-cobbleeff: Lights in the night sky over the desert are often swarms of these little saucers. They hum as they drift, and they lift curious objects up in their tractor beams to study them with their one big eye.
cobbleeffort.species.magneton-cobbleeffo: Three saucers linked by a ring of light. They talk to each other without a sound, and the ring spins faster the more they agree.
cobbleeffort.species.maltwort.desc: A bubbling, copper-kettle-shaped creature with sprouting barley ears for arms and a crown of frothy white foam. It hums softly as it warms its internal sugars, attracting sweet-toothed Pokémon from miles around.
cobbleeffort.species.maltwort.name: Maltwort
cobbleeffort.species.mantasma.desc: A Mawntis that hunted on a moonless night and came back as something else. It towers over the trees, its grin glows in the dark, and its ghostly scythes cut through anything without ever missing. Even so, it still clasps its forelegs together the way it did as a Prayling.
cobbleeffort.species.mantasma.name: Mantasma
cobbleeffort.species.mawntis.desc: Its head has split into a maw full of fangs, and a second set of legs lets it run down prey in the undergrowth. It still has no eyes, but its scythes find their mark every time.
cobbleeffort.species.mawntis.name: Mawntis
cobbleeffort.species.meadbee.desc: Ancient warriors celebrated victories alongside swarms of Meadbee, whose fermented honey was said to grant courage and song.
cobbleeffort.species.meadbee.name: Meadbee
cobbleeffort.species.meerschaum.desc: Artisans carve Meerschaum into intricate shapes. The darker and richer its golden-brown coloration, the older and more powerful the Pokémon is.
cobbleeffort.species.meerschaum.name: Meerschaum
cobbleeffort.species.mentholynx.desc: Its icy breath masks the harshness of winter air, lulling lost travelers into staying out in the cold far longer than they should.
cobbleeffort.species.mentholynx.name: Mentholynx
cobbleeffort.species.mesmerboa.desc: Its tail is so long it never touches the ground: it hangs round Mesmerboa in a great ring that crackles with electricity. Spun fast, the ring can put a whole herd of Pokémon to sleep at once.
cobbleeffort.species.mesmerboa.name: Mesmerboa
cobbleeffort.species.metapod-cobbleeffor: Its shell is studded with bright yellow spots that shout poison to anything that would eat it. Inside, the toxins it gathered as a Caterpie are being brewed into wing scales.
cobbleeffort.species.minnolith.desc: A tiny fish that swam in rivers long before any other Pokémon. Its round body is wrapped in thin plates of armour, and schools of them darted through the shallows like scattered pebbles.
cobbleeffort.species.minnolith.name: Minnolith
cobbleeffort.species.modwing.desc: Bulkier and boxier than Vapulon, Modwing sports dual battery cells on its flanks and an adjustable airflow ring around its neck that whistles when it dives.
cobbleeffort.species.modwing.name: Modwing
cobbleeffort.species.moonshiner.desc: Moonshiner builds hidden stills deep in mountain forests, using reflective mirrors to hide its campfire smoke from patrolling Ranger Pokémon.
cobbleeffort.species.moonshiner.name: Moonshiner
cobbleeffort.species.mousense.desc: Its eyes stay shut from the day it hatches. It feels its way about with its long whiskers, which can pick up the flutter of a moth's wings across a meadow, so sneaking up on it is near impossible.
cobbleeffort.species.mousense.name: Mousense
cobbleeffort.species.mudbray-cobbleeffor: It dyes its mane black, lets its fringe fall over its eyes and wears the pattern of a skeleton on its hide. It sulks in the shadows and kicks at anyone who calls it a phase.
cobbleeffort.species.mumossum.desc: It carries a half dozen of its babies wherever it goes. When something threatens them it plucks the bravest ones off its back and slings them at the enemy with its tail; they come straight back to it, very pleased with themselves.
cobbleeffort.species.mumossum.name: Mumossum
cobbleeffort.species.mumpillar.desc: It wraps itself in strips of silk soaked in river water and never takes them off. Old tales say anyone who unwraps one is cursed, and that it cannot be finished off: struck down, it rises again angrier than before.
cobbleeffort.species.mumpillar.name: Mumpillar
cobbleeffort.species.mycolith.desc: Revived from the Spire Fossil. Over 400 million years ago, fields of Mycolith dominated the barren land before true trees ever took root. Researchers originally mistook its fossilized remains for ancient timber.
cobbleeffort.species.mycolith.name: Mycolith
cobbleeffort.species.nicodrake.desc: Ancient murals depict shamans summoning Nicodrake through ceremonial braziers to commune with spirits and sharpen their minds.
cobbleeffort.species.nicodrake.name: Nicodrake
cobbleeffort.species.nicotiny.desc: Farmers once planted Nicotiny around their gardens to keep Caterpie away, though touching its leaves gives trainers a sudden dizzy spell.
cobbleeffort.species.nicotiny.name: Nicotiny
cobbleeffort.species.nosfiretu.desc: It wraps itself in its wings like a cape and stands perfectly still in the dark, until something warm passes by. Then it drinks the heat from its prey, leaving it shivering.
cobbleeffort.species.nosfiretu.name: Nosfiretu
cobbleeffort.species.obubby.desc: It clings to its mother's back for weeks after it is born, hugging its own long tail when it gets scared. When something startles it, it flops over and plays dead, curl of hair and all.
cobbleeffort.species.obubby.name: Obubby
cobbleeffort.species.ontherox.desc: Unlike normal ice, Ontherox is forged under immense pressure, making it so dense that it clinks like solid stone and takes weeks to thaw.
cobbleeffort.species.ontherox.name: Ontherox
cobbleeffort.species.operbat.desc: It hides its face behind a golden mask and performs for anyone who will listen, singing in a voice so high that windows crack. It never takes the mask off.
cobbleeffort.species.operbat.name: Operbat
cobbleeffort.species.orthodread.desc: Eight teeth held together by braces it can never take off. It scuttles through dark caves on its steel legs and its bite can crunch through iron. The braces put it in a foul mood, and it takes that out on anyone it meets.
cobbleeffort.species.orthodread.name: Orthodread
cobbleeffort.species.ovarupa.desc: Inside its hard orange casing its whole body is being rebuilt. The horn grows out through the top first, and anything that pokes the casing gets jabbed with it.
cobbleeffort.species.ovarupa.name: Ovarupa
cobbleeffort.species.peatling.desc: Dug up from ancient coastal bogs, Peatling burns slowly for centuries, infusing nearby water springs with its distinct smoky flavor.
cobbleeffort.species.peatling.name: Peatling
cobbleeffort.species.pennacrest.desc: The matriarch of a crag-top nest. It broods over the chicks with its broad crest spread like a parasol to shade them, and drives off any intruder with a storm of beating wings and lashing streamers.
cobbleeffort.species.pennacrest.name: Pennacrest
cobbleeffort.species.petroleodd.desc: A pile of tar from the bottom of an ancient tar pit, brought back to life with the bones of old Pokémon still inside it. It is sleepy and slow, and anything that touches it comes away stuck.
cobbleeffort.species.petroleodd.name: Petroleodd
cobbleeffort.species.petroleossil.desc: Holding a King's Rock, Petroleodd swallows tar and sludge until it becomes a mountain of it, with the fossil skull of an ancient tyrant floating up through the middle. It roars through its jaws.
cobbleeffort.species.petroleossil.name: Petroleossil
cobbleeffort.species.phanturn.desc: It drifts up out of the deep at night, trailing glowing pearls. Lost sailors follow the light of its little golden lure, thinking it is a lantern on the shore, and are never seen again.
cobbleeffort.species.phanturn.name: Phanturn
cobbleeffort.species.pharantis.desc: It rules the river valleys with a crook of gold at the end of each scythe, and moves so fast its foes never see it strike. Those who think they have defeated it soon learn about the pharaoh's curse.
cobbleeffort.species.pharantis.name: Pharantis
cobbleeffort.species.pinlet.desc: Pinlet chicks wait in the nest with their beaks wide open, shrieking until a Pinnant drops a berry in. The star-shaped glints in their eyes fade as they grow up.
cobbleeffort.species.pinlet.name: Pinlet
cobbleeffort.species.pinnant.desc: It trails its two long streamers like pennants as it flies between the crag and the berry bushes, bringing food back for the chicks. Flocks tell each other apart by the bands on their streamers.
cobbleeffort.species.pinnant.name: Pinnant
cobbleeffort.species.pipider.desc: One of the smallest Pokémon there is: it fits on a fingertip. It hides under a seed it found and carries it everywhere like a shell, and when it is frightened it tucks its legs in and pretends to be an ordinary seed.
cobbleeffort.species.pipider.name: Pipider
cobbleeffort.species.placofin.desc: Its bullet-shaped head is armoured like a battering ram. It crept along ancient riverbeds on its little legs, and when it charged, the force of it could crack the stones of the riverbank.
cobbleeffort.species.placofin.name: Placofin
cobbleeffort.species.prayling.desc: It is born without eyes, yet it never misses. It feels the faintest stir of air through its leafy feelers and knows exactly where its prey is, then holds its little forelegs together and waits.
cobbleeffort.species.prayling.name: Prayling
cobbleeffort.species.primaclaw.desc: Its two claws imitate the ancient titans of land and sea so perfectly that the sight of a Primaclaw on the shore once sent whole villages fleeing inland. The crab itself is tiny, hiding between the two great heads.
cobbleeffort.species.primaclaw.name: Primaclaw
cobbleeffort.species.pterygant.desc: The largest sea scorpion that ever lived. It swept its great paddles to chase down prey in the ancient seas, and nothing that swam could outlast it.
cobbleeffort.species.pterygant.name: Pterygant
cobbleeffort.species.pungallium.desc: Its great flower-head smells so strongly that its own eyes stream with tears and its tongue hangs out in disgust. Bug Pokémon that come to feed on its nectar fall from the air in a faint.
cobbleeffort.species.pungallium.name: Pungallium
cobbleeffort.species.rabbrute.desc: The family form of Hopple. When a den is threatened, its Hopples pile into one another and fuse into a titan as tall as a mountain; every white tuft on it is a little face, and every red speck an eye watching over the family.
cobbleeffort.species.rabbrute.name: Rabbrute
cobbleeffort.species.raddent.desc: It plants itself in a vegetable patch and pretends to be a radish until the farmer goes home, then nibbles everything in sight. Pull on its leaves and it squeaks and bolts.
cobbleeffort.species.raddent.name: Raddent
cobbleeffort.species.rattlebunch.desc: Several Raddent whose leaves grew tangled together in the same patch, tied fast with a farmer's twine. They argue constantly about which way to run, but when they agree, nothing can catch them.
cobbleeffort.species.rattlebunch.name: Rattlebunch
cobbleeffort.species.regideity.desc: Legends say it towed the continents into place with its six arms and stood astride the seas while it worked. When it walks, mountains shake as if in an earthquake, and the halos round its ring shine brighter the longer it has been awake.
cobbleeffort.species.regideity.name: Regideity
cobbleeffort.species.rubraptor.desc: A proud hawk that guards its territory from the treetops. Its red wings flash like a warning as it dives, yet it is gentle with Pokémon smaller than itself and shares its catch with them.
cobbleeffort.species.rubraptor.name: Rubraptor
cobbleeffort.species.sakekoi.desc: Sakekoi thrives in steaming mountain springs. Locals believe a visit from one brings prosperity, harmony, and a bountiful rice harvest.
cobbleeffort.species.sakekoi.name: Sakekoi
cobbleeffort.species.sarcoon.desc: Its silk hardens into a coffin painted like a pharaoh's. It lies still for weeks, but anything foolish enough to pry at the lid wakes the curse, and the case's eyes light up.
cobbleeffort.species.sarcoon.name: Sarcoon
cobbleeffort.species.sawk-gi.desc: A Sawk that has earned the Master's Gi. Its focus is so sharp that it crackles: every chop lands with a thunderclap, and its belt and collar spit sparks as it moves.
cobbleeffort.species.scorpaddle.desc: A sea scorpion from the oldest oceans. It rows along the sea floor with its paddles and holds its tail spike up like a warning, though the spike was only ever for show.
cobbleeffort.species.scorpaddle.name: Scorpaddle
cobbleeffort.species.sensarat.desc: It sweeps its long whiskers through the dark like feelers and senses an attack before it comes, striking first. It never opens its eyes; those who have seen them say they are as bright as stars.
cobbleeffort.species.sensarat.name: Sensarat
cobbleeffort.species.shallorn.desc: It has stopped crying and grown gloomy instead, drooping its leaves over its face and sighing into its moustache. The faint stink around it keeps everyone at a polite distance.
cobbleeffort.species.shallorn.name: Shallorn
cobbleeffort.species.sharkindle.desc: It swims through the ground near lava as easily as a shark through water, its orange fins glowing where they cut through the hot rock. Its bite can dent iron.
cobbleeffort.species.sharkindle.name: Sharkindle
cobbleeffort.species.sheathalis.desc: Its cocoon hardens into something like a block of wood with knife handles sticking out of it. The blades inside are its new wings growing, and it peeks out of the front to keep watch.
cobbleeffort.species.sheathalis.name: Sheathalis
cobbleeffort.species.shivnymph.desc: It hatches near water with a tiny blade already at the end of its tail. It keeps the edge sharp by scraping it on river stones, and flicks it at anything that comes too close.
cobbleeffort.species.shivnymph.name: Shivnymph
cobbleeffort.species.slackey.desc: It spends its days floating in its swim ring and only moves when something gets close enough to punch. One lazy swipe of its arm sends a wave over the whole lake.
cobbleeffort.species.slackey.name: Slackey
cobbleeffort.species.smolderstump.desc: Its papery armor has burned away almost entirely, leaving a jagged, ash-crusted torso and a thick collar of acrid gray smoke. It becomes grumpy and sluggish when wet, coughing out choking clouds of soot.
cobbleeffort.species.smolderstump.name: Smolderstump
cobbleeffort.species.snuffel.desc: Snuffel stores pulverized herbs in tiny pouches near its snout. A single pinch wakes it up instantly from hibernation.
cobbleeffort.species.snuffel.name: Snuffel
cobbleeffort.species.sommelgeist.desc: Sommelgeist haunts centuries-old underground cellars, judging the quality of buried casks and guarding rare vintages from thieves.
cobbleeffort.species.sommelgeist.name: Sommelgeist
cobbleeffort.species.sounflame.desc: Its huge ears hear the crackle of a campfire from a mile away. It sneaks up to warm its wings by the flames and steals the sparks to feed its own.
cobbleeffort.species.sounflame.name: Sounflame
cobbleeffort.species.spiritskull.desc: Legend says Spiritskull forms inside abandoned bottles left on sunken ships. Those who drink from it experience vivid memories that aren't their own.
cobbleeffort.species.spiritskull.name: Spiritskull
cobbleeffort.species.splakey.desc: It strikes a pose after every splash, dripping and proud. It practises its moves in rivers and waterfalls for hours, then sleeps for the rest of the day.
cobbleeffort.species.splakey.name: Splakey
cobbleeffort.species.squeakling.desc: It bobs along on rivers and ponds without a care, and squeaks whenever it is squeezed. Its body is light and springy, so it never sinks, however rough the water.
cobbleeffort.species.squeakling.name: Squeakling
cobbleeffort.species.stillforge.desc: Engineered by master craftsmen, Stillforge boils impure water inside its copper belly and condenses it into pure, elemental energy.
cobbleeffort.species.stillforge.name: Stillforge
cobbleeffort.species.stumblepup.desc: Trained to rescue lost hikers in snowy passes, Stumblepup carries a warming tonic in its neck barrel—though it often spills half of it tripping over its own paws.
cobbleeffort.species.stumblepup.name: Stumblepup
cobbleeffort.species.subohmega.desc: A heavy, industrial-grade mechanical falcon constructed from brushed stainless steel and glowing resistance coils. Its chest glows cherry-red before it unleashes colossal, storm-sized plumes of electrified vapor.
cobbleeffort.species.subohmega.name: Subohmega
cobbleeffort.species.sunflare.desc: On the hottest days of summer its petals burst into flame. It turns its burning face to follow the sun across the sky and stores so much heat that it glows all through the night.
cobbleeffort.species.sunflare.name: Sunflare
cobbleeffort.species.tanhyll.desc: It stands up on its hind legs to tear open Bug Pokémon nests with its huge claws, then slurps up everything inside with its long hooked tongue. Bug Pokémon flee at its very scent.
cobbleeffort.species.tanhyll.name: Tanhyll
cobbleeffort.species.tarragon.desc: Born from the accumulated grime of industrial chimneys, Tarragon's heavy, tar-soaked wings make flight difficult, forcing it to crawl along cavern walls.
cobbleeffort.species.tarragon.name: Tarragon
cobbleeffort.species.tavernhound.desc: It strides the snowy passes with a full keg of warm tonic under its chin, and lost hikers who hear it baying know help is coming, slowly but surely.
cobbleeffort.species.tavernhound.name: Tavern Hound
cobbleeffort.species.taxitower.desc: Towering over ancient swamps, Taxitower absorbed nutrients from the surrounding soil through miles of underground threads. When threatened, it releases blinding clouds of prehistoric spores that haven't been breathed in eons.
cobbleeffort.species.taxitower.name: Taxitower
cobbleeffort.species.tearion.desc: It cries all the time, and so does everyone standing near it. It buries itself up to its leaves in garden soil and sobs quietly when it is pulled up.
cobbleeffort.species.tearion.name: Tearion
cobbleeffort.species.tentacool-cobbleeff: It lives in the dark of the deep sea, where it lures prey with the blue rings glowing on its mantle. The hooked rings on its two long tentacles never let go of what they catch.
cobbleeffort.species.tentacruel-cobbleef: A giant of the abyss. The tips of its eight arms glow like a swarm of fireflies to dazzle its prey, and it seizes it with the dark hooks on its tentacle clubs. Its eyes are the largest of any Pokémon that lives in the sea.
cobbleeffort.species.throh-gi.desc: A Throh that has earned the Master's Gi. Its fighting spirit burns so hot that its gi never catches fire; foes it throws land wreathed in flames.
cobbleeffort.species.tikilla.desc: Its fists have grown as big as tiki masks, and it carves faces into them to look fiercer. It leads its troop with thundering kicks and shakes its great white mane to warn rivals away.
cobbleeffort.species.tikilla.name: Tikilla
cobbleeffort.species.tikimp.desc: It paints its face like a skull to scare off bigger Pokémon, then kickboxes anything that isn't scared. It practises its kicks on bamboo all day long and never seems to tire.
cobbleeffort.species.tikimp.name: Tikimp
cobbleeffort.species.typeerror.desc: A failed experiment built to be faster and deadlier than any other. The mask clamped over its head keeps its corrupted power in check. Its type cannot be read: every attack hits it the same, except the most ordinary ones.
cobbleeffort.species.typeerror.name: Type: Error
cobbleeffort.species.tyrucrab.desc: To scare off predators it holds up its right claw, which has grown into the shape of a fearsome tyrannosaur's head. The jaw snaps like a pincer, and a Tyrucrab that fools a foe once never stops boasting about it.
cobbleeffort.species.tyrucrab.name: Tyrucrab
cobbleeffort.species.vapulon.desc: Popular among younger trainers in bustling cities, Vapulon charges itself at wall outlets and exhales massive plumes that smell faintly of artificial berries.
cobbleeffort.species.vapulon.name: Vapulon
cobbleeffort.species.violinisant.desc: It plays its long beak like a violin, drawing a twig across it as a bow. Its performances move listeners to tears, and those who heckle it find themselves unable to stop dancing.
cobbleeffort.species.violinisant.name: Violinisant
cobbleeffort.species.whippersnap.desc: It looks half asleep, but its whip antennae never stop feeling around it. The moment one brushes prey, its little claws snap shut faster than the eye can follow.
cobbleeffort.species.whippersnap.name: Whippersnap
cobbleeffort.species.whissant.desc: It whistles through its leafy wing all day long. It never plays the same tune twice, and it gets very smug when other Pokémon stop to listen.
cobbleeffort.species.whissant.name: Whissant
cobbleeffort.species.wigwoof.desc: The blond tuft on its head is a clump of dry grass it never stops growing. It hides its eyes under it when it is shy, and fluffs it up to look bigger when it wants to look tough.
cobbleeffort.species.wigwoof.name: Wigwoof
cobbleeffort.species.wispuff.desc: It clings to curtains and clothing long after leaving a room. You can always tell when a Wispuff has passed through by the stale chill in the air.
cobbleeffort.species.wispuff.name: Wispuff
cobbleeffort.species.wolfevel.desc: It has started walking on two legs and picks fights with anything bigger than itself, just to prove it can. Its tail turns redder the angrier it gets.
cobbleeffort.species.wolfevel.name: Wolfevel
cobbleeffort.species.wrapiglet.desc: It wraps itself in a soft blanket of dough as soon as it hatches and naps in it the whole day long. The dough bakes golden in the sun, and it smells so good that Pokémon follow it around.
cobbleeffort.species.wrapiglet.name: Wrapiglet
cobbleeffort.species.writhingrot.desc: An ancient Pokémon said to be the distant past of Sudowoodo, described in an old expedition journal. Its log body is only a shell: the real Pokémon is the pale, writhing thing that lives inside it, and it lunges out on a long neck to snatch prey.
cobbleeffort.species.writhingrot.name: Writhing Rot
cobbleeffort.species.zippolt.desc: Celebrated for its signature metallic clink, Zippolt can keep its tiny flame alive even in the middle of a fierce gale.
cobbleeffort.species.zippolt.name: Zippolt
cobbleeffort.species.zynx.desc: Compact and discreet, Zynx hides inside trainers' pockets. A single touch gives an instant jolt of icy clarity and focus.
cobbleeffort.species.zynx.name: Zynx
cobblemon.ability.agedvintage.desc: It only gets better with age: at the end of every turn it stays in battle, one of its stats other than accuracy and evasion, picked at random, rises by 1 stage.
cobblemon.ability.alkaloidsap.desc: Its curled leaves ooze a fermented, dizzying sap: a Pokémon that touches it has a 30% chance of being poisoned or confused.
cobblemon.ability.alpinespirit.desc: Born for the high passes: its Speed doubles in snow or hail, it takes no damage from hail or sandstorms, and it can't be frozen.
cobblemon.ability.aromaticharvest.desc: In sun or rain its hop bracts give off a soothing scent: at the end of every turn it and its allies restore 1/16 of their maximum HP.
cobblemon.ability.blindsight.desc: The Pokémon is blind, yet it senses everything around it: every move it uses hits, whatever its accuracy, and even targets that are flying, underground or underwater.
cobblemon.ability.cloudchaser.desc: On entering battle it exhales a thick, sweet-smelling fog that lasts five turns: Electric-type moves grow 30% stronger in it, and the moves of non-Electric Pokémon lose a fifth of their accuracy.
cobblemon.ability.condenser.desc: Its cooling coils condense heat into pure water: Fire-type moves don't harm it, they restore 1/4 of its maximum HP.
cobblemon.ability.fermentation.desc: It ferments whatever ails it into sugar: instead of losing HP to poison or a burn, it restores 1/8 of its maximum HP every turn.
cobblemon.ability.frothyguard.desc: The thick, pillowy foam on its shoulders cushions blows: moves that make contact deal 30% less damage to it.
cobblemon.ability.highproof.desc: It refines raw energy into blazing high-proof plasma: its Fire-type moves are 30% stronger and burn even Water-type Pokémon at full strength (Water no longer resists them).
cobblemon.ability.hivemind.desc: Thousands of fallen Bug Pokémon live on in it, bound by a fungus: a Bug-type foe's moves can never harm it. The hive seizes them, and the attack strikes the foe's own side instead.
cobblemon.ability.hooked.desc: One taste and they keep coming back: a Pokémon that makes contact with it can't switch out on the next turn.
cobblemon.ability.insectivore.desc: The Pokémon was made to hunt Bug Pokémon: all of its attacks are extremely super effective (4x) on Bug types, whatever their type, and nothing about them makes a Bug type immune.
cobblemon.ability.lingeringember.desc: Its fragrant smoke keeps old embers smouldering: at the end of each turn, every burned opposing Pokémon loses another 1/16 of its maximum HP.
cobblemon.ability.lingeringscent.desc: Even after it faints, its stale haze hangs over the field for three turns, taking 1/16 of their HP from every Pokémon that isn't Ghost type at the end of each turn.
cobblemon.ability.liquidcourage.desc: A swig from its barrel steadies its nerve: it ignores Intimidate, and its Attack rises by 1 stage whenever it gets a status condition or becomes confused.
cobblemon.ability.oakmaturation.desc: Berries ripen inside its oak shell: a Berry it holds has twice the effect, and two turns after it eats one, a new one of the same kind has matured in its place.
cobblemon.ability.overclockedcoil.desc: It runs its coils past their limit: its Electric-type moves are 50% stronger, but each one it uses costs it 1/10 of its maximum HP in heat.
cobblemon.ability.paleomycelium.desc: An ancient fungus long mistaken for a plant: its Grass-type moves get the same-type bonus, and it is immune to Leech Seed and to powder and spore moves.
cobblemon.ability.patinapolish.desc: Heat and smoke only deepen its golden patina: when a Fire- or Poison-type move hits it, its Defense and Sp. Def rise by one stage.
cobblemon.ability.pestdeterrent.desc: Its sticky leaves ooze a mild toxin that Bug Pokémon can't stand: when it enters battle, the Attack of every opposing Bug-type Pokémon falls.
cobblemon.ability.pharaohscurse.desc: Once per battle, a hit that would knock the Pokémon out doesn't: it rises again at half its HP and its Attack and Sp. Atk sharply rise.
cobblemon.ability.primalmimicry.desc: One claw imitates the titan of the land, the other the titan of the sea: its Water-type moves get the same-type bonus as well.
cobblemon.ability.resincoat.desc: Its body is thick with sticky tar: moves that make contact deal half damage, and the attacker comes away gummed up, its Speed lowered.
cobblemon.ability.secondhandhaze.desc: It enters battle coughing out choking clouds of soot, lowering the accuracy of every opposing Pokémon.
cobblemon.ability.slowmelt.desc: Dense ice that melts only slowly: super-effective Fire-type moves deal half damage, and when a Fire-type move hits it, its meltwater slicks the ground and lowers the Speed of every opposing Pokémon.
cobblemon.ability.smokycask.desc: Its Fire- and Poison-type moves are 30% stronger, and when it enters battle it fills the field with thick peat smoke for five turns, in which no Pokémon's stats can be lowered by another.
cobblemon.ability.steadyrelease.desc: Its steady psychic pulse calms its side: at the end of every turn it and its allies snap out of confusion and each of their moves regains 1 PP.
cobblemon.ability.systemerror.desc: The Pokémon's type is Error: every move hits it for neutral damage except Normal-type moves, which are super effective. Its own Normal-type moves hit everything for neutral damage, ghosts included, and are super effective on Normal types.
cobblemon.ability.toxingourmet.desc: It feeds on plant toxins: Poison- and Grass-type moves don't harm it, they restore 1/4 of its HP.
cobblemon.ability.warminfusion.desc: It swims in warmed waters: a Fire-type hit raises its Sp. Atk, it can't be frozen, and it thaws every frozen Pokémon in its party when it enters battle and at the end of each turn.
cobblemon.battle.activate.calloftheden: %1$s thumped the ground and called its family!
cobblemon.battle.activate.smokycask: The peat smoke shields %1$s from losing its stats!
cobblemon.battle.activate.steadyrelease: %1$s was steadied by a calm, rhythmic pulse!
cobblemon.battle.damage.contrabandswap: %1$s was caught in the exploding jug!
cobblemon.battle.damage.devoniandrift: %1$s is weighed down by the ancient spores!
cobblemon.battle.damage.effervescentroar: %1$s is buffeted by the sparkling bubbles!
cobblemon.battle.damage.hivemind: %1$s was struck by its own side's attack!
cobblemon.battle.damage.smother: %1$s is hurt by the smothering ash!
cobblemon.battle.damage.yeastbubble: %1$s is hurt by the sticky foam!
cobblemon.battle.end.smother: %1$s dug itself out of the ash!
cobblemon.battle.fieldstart.cloudchaser: A thick, sweet-smelling fog rolled across the field!
cobblemon.battle.fieldstart.lingeringsce: A stale haze lingers over the field...
cobblemon.battle.fieldstart.smokycask: Thick, earthy peat smoke filled the field!
cobblemon.battle.fieldstart.twincoilsurg: A thick vapour cloud rolled over the field!
cobblemon.battle.sideend.ally.devoniandr: The ancient spores around your team settled!
cobblemon.battle.sideend.ally.effervesce: The bubbles around your team went flat!
cobblemon.battle.sideend.opponent.devoni: The ancient spores around the opposing team settled!
cobblemon.battle.sideend.opponent.efferv: The bubbles around the opposing team went flat!
cobblemon.battle.sidestart.ally.devonian: Ancient spores drifted down around your team!
cobblemon.battle.sidestart.ally.efferves: Sparkling bubbles fizzed up around your team!
cobblemon.battle.sidestart.opponent.devo: Ancient spores drifted down around the opposing team!
cobblemon.battle.sidestart.opponent.effe: Sparkling bubbles fizzed up around the opposing team!
cobblemon.battle.start.hooked: %1$s got hooked and can't bring itself to leave!
cobblemon.move.alkaloidroar.desc: The user lets out a ringing roar laced with alkaloids that cuts through substitutes. It may paralyze a Pokémon with sturdy Defense, or poison one that relies on its Sp. Def.
cobblemon.move.ashchoke.desc: The user coughs a choking cloud of soot at the target, lowering its accuracy. It hits twice as hard if the target is burned.
cobblemon.move.barroomblitz.desc: The user throws a flurry of wild haymakers, two to five of them. They hit twice as hard if the user is confused.
cobblemon.move.blueignition.desc: The user sets its pure spirit ablaze in a cool, ghost-blue flame. It is super effective against Water types, and it may leave a burn.
cobblemon.move.bubblefilter.desc: The user draws the air on its side through its bubbling water, filtering away hazards and curing its party's status conditions, and blasts the target with scalding steam that may burn it.
cobblemon.move.calloftheden.desc: The user thumps the ground and calls its family: its Attack and Defense rise by 1 stage for every other Hopple in its party (up to 2). Outside battle, with three or more Hopples in the party, it fuses them all into a towering Rabbrute (from the interaction wheel).
cobblemon.move.cherryflick.desc: The user flicks the glowing tip of its snout at the target faster than it can react, scattering hot ash. Usually goes first, and may leave a burn.
cobblemon.move.condense.desc: The user condenses the air round it, clearing away the weather and the terrain, and raises its Defense and Sp. Def.
cobblemon.move.contrabandswap.desc: The user swipes the target's held item and slips it a volatile jug of moonshine instead. At the end of the next turn the jug explodes, dealing Dark-type damage.
cobblemon.move.devoniandrift.desc: Scatters heavy, ancient spores over the opposing side for five turns. At the end of each turn they hurt every grounded opponent that isn't Poison or Steel type and weigh it down, lowering its Speed.
cobblemon.move.distill.desc: The user boils away its impurities, curing its status condition and its lowered stats, and condenses them into pure energy: its Sp. Atk rises sharply if anything was purified, or by 1 stage otherwise.
cobblemon.move.effervescentroar.desc: A joyous, sparkling roar that hits every opposing Pokémon, cures its party's status conditions and leaves fizzing bubbles round the opposing side that hurt them at the end of each turn for three turns.
cobblemon.move.flintsnap.desc: The user snaps its lid open and strikes its flint wheel, throwing a windproof spark that never misses and often leaves a burn.
cobblemon.move.frostbitedrag.desc: A numbing menthol bite: the target doesn't feel it until the turn is ending, and nothing it hides behind, Protect, a substitute or a screen, can stop it.
cobblemon.move.frostroundhouse.desc: The user spins and delivers a roundhouse kick that freezes the air. Critical hits land more easily, and it may also leave the target frozen.
cobblemon.move.goldenleafstorm.desc: The user whips up a storm of cured golden leaves that slows the target and may badly poison it.
cobblemon.move.greenmuse.desc: The user swirls a cloud of emerald mist round the target, confusing it and lowering its Sp. Def, and draws inspiration from it to raise its own Sp. Atk.
cobblemon.move.hangover.desc: Haunted liquor's memory of the night before. If the target's last move was a status move that raised stats, it hits twice as hard and the target loses all its stat changes.
cobblemon.move.infernotoss.desc: The user grabs the target and hurls it away in a ring of fire, forcing it to switch out. It may also leave the target with a burn. In the wild, the battle ends.
cobblemon.move.joeyslingshot.desc: The user plucks its babies off its back and slingshots them at the target with its tail, one after another: six hits in a row.
cobblemon.move.liptingle.desc: An icy minty jolt sharply raises the user's Speed and Sp. Atk, but at the end of the next turn the buzz fades and both fall by one stage.
cobblemon.move.machinegunstinger.desc: Spins up its Gatling arms and sprays the target with red-hot stingers two to five times in a row. Each stinger may leave the target with a burn.
cobblemon.move.nectartoast.desc: The user raises a toast of fermented nectar with its allies: it and every ally on the field restore half their HP and gain courage, raising their Attack.
cobblemon.move.popoff.desc: The user corkscrews into the target and pops out with a loud thunk. It breaks through Protect and shatters Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil, and lands critical hits more easily.
cobblemon.move.roastpress.desc: The user crushes the target under its spiny core like an agave in the press. It hits twice as hard if the last move to hit the target was a Fire-type move.
cobblemon.move.smokering.desc: The user blows a glowing ring of ghost-fire around the target, trapping it so it can't switch out and lowering its Sp. Def.
cobblemon.move.smother.desc: The user buries the target in hot ash, trapping it and hurting it every turn for four or five turns. It may also leave a burn.
cobblemon.move.sneezefit.desc: The user lets out a violent sneeze of aromatic dust that blows the target out of battle and sweeps entry hazards off both sides. It goes last.
cobblemon.move.spittoonslug.desc: The user spits a slug of concentrated dark juice with bullet-like force. It hits harder if the target is holding an item.
cobblemon.move.thunderchop.desc: The user chops the target with a hand crackling with lightning. Critical hits land more easily, and it may also leave the target with paralysis.
cobblemon.move.twincoilsurge.desc: The user fires both of its coils in turn, hitting twice, and leaves a thick vapour on the field for five turns in which Flying-type Pokémon are harder to hit.
cobblemon.move.warmingdraught.desc: The user shares warming sips of herbal tonic: it and its allies are thawed and cured of burns, and restore 35% of their HP.
cobblemon.move.yeastbubble.desc: The user traps the target in sticky, bubbling foam that hurts it every turn for four or five turns, while the warm fermentation restores a little of the user's HP each turn.
cobblemon.move.zestshock.desc: A jolt of electrified citrus zest: it sharply raises the user's Speed, and the crackle wakes every Pokémon on the field.
cobblemon.species.brutebonnet-mega.desc: Its stalk has grown into a colossal trunk like the giant fungi of ancient times, taller than the trees around it. Moss hangs from its cap, and its fists can fell a forest.
cobblemon.species.fluttermane-mega.desc: Its feathery mane spreads like great wings and its beads glow with eerie light. Its cries are said to drive whole villages from their homes.
cobblemon.species.gougingfire-mega.desc: Its golden mane flares into a crown of flame. The ground smoulders under its hooves.
cobblemon.species.greattusk-mega.desc: Its tusks have grown into great curling arcs and its hide into stone-hard plates. It rolls through mountains as if they were sand.
cobblemon.species.ironboulder-mega.desc: Its horn-blade glows white-hot and its armour has grown into a moving fortress.
cobblemon.species.ironbundle-mega.desc: Its sack has become a huge cannon of ice. It glides through blizzards it makes itself.
cobblemon.species.ironcrown-mega.desc: Its crest-blades have spread into a crown of floating swords that guard it on every side.
cobblemon.species.ironhands-mega.desc: Its hands have grown into colossal pistons. One punch can flatten a building.
cobblemon.species.ironjugulis-mega.desc: Its three heads glow with targeting lights and its wings have turned to blades.
cobblemon.species.ironleaves-mega.desc: Its blade-horns have grown into a crest of glowing swords that can cut through steel.
cobblemon.species.ironmoth-mega.desc: Its wing panels have spread into a blazing halo that scorches the air around it.
cobblemon.species.ironthorns-mega.desc: Its armour has thickened into a fortress of spikes humming with electricity.
cobblemon.species.irontreads-mega.desc: Its treads have widened into great glowing wheels. It speeds across the land like a runaway train.
cobblemon.species.ironvaliant-mega.desc: Its blades have lengthened into a flowing cape of light. It fights as gracefully as it dances.
cobblemon.species.koraidon-mega.desc: Its wing-feathers have unfurled into a blazing crown. The sun is said to burn hotter wherever it spreads them.
cobblemon.species.miraidon-mega.desc: Its body-fins have flared into wings of pure light. It races through the sky faster than lightning.
cobblemon.species.ragingbolt-mega.desc: Its storm-cloud mane crackles constantly. Lightning is said to answer its roar.
cobblemon.species.roaringmoon-mega.desc: Its wings have joined into a great crescent like a blood-red moon. Old tales say it rose on nights when the moon turned red.
cobblemon.species.sandyshocks-mega.desc: Its magnets have grown into great arches crackling with sand. It drags whole sandstorms behind it.
cobblemon.species.screamtail-mega.desc: Its fluffy mane bristles and its tail has grown long enough to coil round its foes. Its scream can shatter boulders.
cobblemon.species.slitherwing-mega.desc: Its six wings blaze like a wildfire. It crawls through the forest on its many legs, scorching all it touches.
cobblemon.species.walkingwake-mega.desc: Its mane streams like burning water. Old stories say rain followed wherever it walked.
